Commentary.Commentary: The opener Masakadza and Waller were the only ones to put up a fight as the rest failed to get partnerships going. Every time they threatened to do so, Sandakan got the better of them. Hasaranga cleaned up the tail in an over to become the FIRST SRI LANKAN PLAYER TO TAKE A HAT-TRICK ON THE ODI DEBUT. The visitors will be disappointed with their batting effort. A lot of them got starts but could not get going. The target isn't a big one and Sri Lanka will aim to get it in time. Join us in a while for the chase.

The pair of Lakshan Sandakan and Wanidu Hasaranga shared seven wickets between them to run through the Zimbabwe batting line-up. They did not start ideally, dropping Hamilton Masakadza but came back hard with the slower bowlers. It were the spinners who had no clue in the previous game but this time around, they were too good for the visitors. The ploy to play the sweep shot brings its own risk and the tourists discovered that today.

OUT! Hat-trick on ODI debut for Wanidu Hasaranga! What an effort! Wanidu fires the googly full and around off, Chatara fails to bring his bat down in line and has his stumps disturbed. The bowler takes off and why not. Not many bowlers take a hat-trick in ODIs, that too in their very first international game. Phew! The tail has been blasted away. 5th Sri Lankan to take a hat-trick. ZIMBABWE BOWLED OUT FOR 155!
Tendai Chatara is the last man in.

OUT! Gone first ball! Hasaranga floats it around off, Tiripano comes forward but plays down the wrong line and is rapped on his pads. The players appeal and the umpire rules it out. Donald does not waste the review as it was pretty plumb! Hasaranga is on a hat-trick.
Donald Tiripano is the penultimate man in.

OUT! Maiden ODI wicket for Hasaranga! Loops it around off, Waller looks to swipe across the line but gets an inside edge which goes onto hit the stumps. First wicket for Hasaranga and Zimbabwe sink further.
FOUR! Superb! Full toss on the stumps, Waller does not miss out and just punches it back past his partner for a boundary down the ground.
Flatter on the pads, worked towards square leg by Cremer. Another tight over by Gunaratne.
Around leg, turned to mid-wicket by Cremer again.
Fuller on middle, Cremer clips it in the air, just short of the mid-wicket fielder.
Flatter on middle and leg, Cremer wants to clip it but gets it off his body back down the wicket.
Fuller outside off, Cremer comes forward and defends it.
Taps this one towards point for a single.
Another bowling change, Asela Gunaratne called back on.
Cremer comes forward and defends it watchfully.

Waller heaves it towards mid on and takes off for a single. Pradeep misses his shy at the bowler's end and hence Waller survives. 150 up for Zimbabwe. Dean Jones on air wonders why Waller did not dive there but replays show that Malcolm had got into his crease.
Fuller on middle and leg, pushed back to the bowler by Waller.
Similar ball, driven through mid off for a single.
Loops it outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Shorter outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Wanidu Hasaranga comes on for a bowl.
Graeme Cremer strides out to bat.

Drinks time at Galle. The hosts are all over the visitors at the moment. Moor and Waller were going well before the star of the day, Sandakan struck to ensure his side remains on top.  Sri Lanka though will want to finish the job here and not let the Zimbabwean tail wag.

OUT! Dragged on! Shorter outside off, Moor wants to cut it but gets an inside edge onto his stumps. Peter cannot believe his luck, fourth wicket for Sandakan. He ends his spell with career-best figures of 10-0-52-4!
Shorter outside off, Moor goes across and punches it towards covers.
Angles it on the stumps, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Goes round the wicket, bowls it outside off, Waller shapes to defend but is beaten all ends up.
FOUR! Just wide! Loops it outside off, Waller goes hard at it. He manages to slice it wide of the diving backward point fielder for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Moor heaves it to long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Shorter again outside off, Moor ducks under it.
Fuller around off, Moor expecting the short one has his weight on his back foot and gets it off the inner half towards the leg side off his pads.
Sharp bouncer from Pradeep, Moor has to duck under it.
Good length around off, Moor stands tall and defends it.
Length ball outside off, Waller angles it towards third man for a single.
Stays back and punches it towards covers.
FOUR! Good shot! Full toss around off, Moor picks it and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary. That was superbly timed as well. Sandakan has bowled quite a few full tosses today.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards deep point for a single.
Flatter on the pads, Waller sweeps it towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
Loops it outside off, Waller looks to come forward and drive but is beaten all ends up.
Shorter outside off, cut through point for a single.
Fuller outside off, hit to short cover from the crease. Waller is not happy that he missed out there.
Bowls it in line of the stumps, Waller keeps it out watchfully.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Shorter length again, this time Waller gets under it and ramps it to the third man fence for a boundary. Smart batting. He is on 22 in just 14 balls.
Back of a length outside off, Waller throws his bat at it but is beaten.
Hurls it around off, pushed towards mid off from the crease.
Shortish outside off, Moor flays it down to third man for a single.
Nuwan Pradeep brought back on. Mathews has got the bowling changes spot on today.

FOUR! In the gap! Full toss outside off, Waller sweeps it through the mid-wicket region. Chameera looks to cut it off going to his left in the deep but cannot do so. Zimbabwe continue to play fire with fire.
Flatter around off, spins in, Waller turns it towards the leg side. Moor wants a single but is sent back.
Googly outside off, Waller goes back and thumps it to covers.
Short leg moves to gully.
EDGED! Flatter outside off, Moor looks to drive but gets an outside edge just wide of the first slip fielder. Three runs taken as the fielder in the deep keeps the ball in play.
Peter Moor walks out to bat.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Sandakan bowls it on the stumps, Burl looks to sweep this one again but fails to connect. The ball sneaks through to hit the timber. Sandakan has struck again, just in time to break a threatening stand. He has three wickets already.
Bowls it too full outside off, Burl shapes to sweep but misses and is hit on his pads.
As expected, Lakshan Sandakan returns for a bowl.

FOUR! Pressure on the debutant! Short and outside off, Waller stands tall and dispatches it through covers for a boundary. 8 runs from the over so the runs continue to flow. Time for Sri Lanka to go back to Sandakan?
Fuller around off, driven to covers.
Stays back and thumps it through covers for a couple of runs.
Punches this one through covers for a single.

Zimbabwe coach credits his batsmen for fighting it out in the last game and is happy that their ploy to play sweeps has worked often. He thinks that the par score today is around 250. Hopes that they will get partnerships going and get to that score.
Cuts this one through point for a single.
Waller comes forward and defends this one.
Time for the debutant! Wanidu Hasaranga introduced into the attack.
This time Burl punches it past the extra cover fielder for a couple of runs. 9 runs from the over along with the wicket.
Shorter in length, punched to covers by Burl.
Nudges this one towards mid-wicket and takes a quick single.
FOUR! Close! Fires it on the stumps, Waller looks to sweep but gets it just wide of the short fine leg fielder for a boundary. Waller playing fire with fire here.
Fuller outside off, Waller drives it through cover-point for a couple to get off the mark.
Malcolm Waller is the new man in.

OUT! What have you done, Williams? Gunathilaka dishes out a full toss around off, Sean sits down to play his favorite sweep. He though hits it straight to the fielder at deep backward square leg. Pradeep does not have to move an inch and that is a wicket gifted by the visitors. Williams is livid with himself for playing that shot. Zimbabwe have not lost half their side.
Spin, spin and more spin! Danushka Gunathilaka comes on.

Interesting observation from the on air commentators that Zimbabwe have scored only 13 percent of their runs against the spinners down the ground. They have been happy to play square of the wicket and the Sri Lanka bowlers have to get them to hit down the ground.
Burl turns it towards the leg side but not for any runs.
Williams comes forward and hits it through mid off for a single.
Fires it outside off, Sean looks to paddle it but misses. The bowler and the keeper appeal but nothing from the umpire. The umpire asks Asela to stay away from the danger area on the crease though.
Flatter on middle, Williams shapes to clip but mistimes it towards mid-wicket.
Lands it outside off, tapped to the left of the point fielder for a quick single.
Fuller on middle, pushed to wide long off for a single. 100 up for Zimbabwe.
Burl this time gets it fine towards long leg for a couple of runs. Finally a shot in control from him against Sandakan.
For some reason, Williams still manages to get across and sweep one towards fine leg. The others have failed to do that successfully.
Quicker on the stumps, Burl gets it off the outer half towards covers for a single.

Flatter on middle and leg, Burl looks to sweep at first but then shapes to defend. The ball lobs off the pads and the short leg fielder takes it. An appeal but nothing from the umpire as there was no bat there.

NOT OUT! Sri Lanka review in vain! Sandakan bowls it around off, Burl shapes to reverse sweep but is hit on his pads. There is a loud appeal for an lbw. The umpire stays put. The bowler is confident and convinces Mathews for a review. The keeper and the short leg fielder are confident too. Replays confirm there was no bat there. Ball Tracker spots that the impact was outside off. So the review is lost. Mathews signals to his bowlers that it was too close.
A confident appeal for an lbw against Burl is turned down. Sri Lanka review. Looks not out.
Lands it outside off, Burl comes forward and drives it back to the bowler.
A short leg in place now.
Shorter around off, cut towards point by the batsman.
Lands it outside off, played to sweeper cover for a single.
Williams paddles this one towards fine leg for a single. He has played this shot often.
Fuller on off, Burl taps it to covers and takes a quick single. There is a shy at the striker's end but no harm done.
Pushes this through covers for a single.
Fuller around off, played back to the bowler.
Asela Gunaratne returns for a bowl.
Ryan Burls walks out to the middle. No Malcolm Waller or Peter Moor yet. Could be to counter the wrist spinner bowling at the moment.

OUT! That was coming, Sikandar was not picking Sandakan! This one is bowled around middle and leg, Raza looks to play the reverse sweep. The ball goes towards backward point where Pradeep leaps and takes a good catch. Sandakan has troubled the Zimbabwean batsmen all day. No heroics for Raza today.
Floats it outside off, Raza comes forward to defend but is beaten all ends up. The keeper takes the bails off in a flash but misses. Sikandar did not pick the googly there.
Full toss from Sandakan, Raza shapes to reverse sweep but finds the point fielder. That should have been put away.
This time he connects and gets a single to fine leg.
Sandakan bowls it outside off, Sean tries to play a similar shot to the previous delivery but is hit on his pads. A stifled appeal turned down.

FOUR! Hit away! Full toss around off, Williams gets low on this and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary. He took it on the full and that made the difference. Zimbabwe are counter-attacking here.

FOUR! Poor line and punished! Short and wide outside off, Sikandar this time crashes it to the right of the deep point fielder for a boundary. The fielder in the deep had no chance of cutting that one off. Poor over from Chameera after the good ones by Sandakan.
Point goes back to the fence.
FOUR! Off the mark! Short and wide outside off, Raza flashes it over the point fielder for a boundary. Chameera has been guilty of bowling that line time and again.
Shorter in length on off and middle, Raza rides the bounce on that one and keeps it down.
Shorter in length outside off, left alone by Raza.
Goes over the wicket and bowls it on middle and leg, Williams cannot clip it and the ball goes off the pads towards the leg side. Leg Bye taken.
Bowls it a touch short around off, Williams defends it watchfully.
Dushmantha Chameera brought back on for a bowl. A slip in place too. Sri Lanka on the attack.
This one spins into Raza from off, Sikandar is hurried onto his back foot but he manages to bring his bat down in time. A testing over by Sandakan.
Goes across and keeps the googly out.
WIDE! Sprays it wide outside off, expecting a charge maybe? Wide signaled. The bowler rubs his hands on the pitch to rough them up.
Loops it on middle, Raza comes forward and blocks it.
Shorter this time the googly, Sikandar again fails to cut it through. They are not picking him at all.
A googly around off, spins away, Raza plays down the wrong line and hence is beaten all ends up.
Bowls it outside off, Williams paddles it towards fine leg for a single.
Lands it outside leg, Raza turns it towards short fine leg and takes off. Williams sends him back in time and hence Raza is safely back as the throw comes in to the keeper. A tight over by Gunaratne.
Raza gets forward and keeps this one out.
Pushes this one to covers where the fielder parries it towards mid off. No runs taken though.
Fuller around off, Raza drives it to mid off. Williams has to get back to his crease as he wanted a single but was sent back.
The Sri Lankan spinners have bowled a lot more slower through the air as Arnold wished for at the toss. The results are out there for all to see.
Punches it through covers for a single.
Lands it outside off, Ervine defends it.

DROPPED! Short and outside off, Raza looks to cut but gets an under edge. The keeper cannot catch that as it hits him on his pads. Such catches either stick or they don't. That would have been disastrous for the visitors.
Sikandar Raza comes out to bat.

OUT! Set batsman departs! Shorter outside off, Ervine looks to cut it through but gets an edge behind. Dickwella takes a good catch and that is a big wicket for the hosts. Two set batsmen have been sent back to the hut. Zimbabwe in a spot of bother here. Craig walks back disappointed.
Short outside off, punched through point for a single.
Floats it around middle, Williams shapes to sweep but misses. A wide signaled.
A slip in place for Williams.
Flatter on the pads, worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! What a shot! Sandakan bowls it outside off, Ervine unfurls a reverse sweep and gets it through the point region for a boundary.
Floats it around off, Ervine defends it.
Sean Williams walks out to bat.
Drinks. A wicket at the right moment for the hosts. Zimbabwe will once again have to build a partnership from hereon.

OUT! Oh Asela, what a catch! Gunaratne bowls it around off and middle, Masakadza is early into his chip shot towards mid on. The bowler though anticipates that and takes a stunner with his right hand. That came out of nowhere really and it shows how good a fielder Gunaratne is. Once again it is him who has broken a good stand. He took a caught and bowled in the previous game too. Timely wicket for the hosts.
Pushes this back down the wicket, the bowler goes to left and stops it.

FOUR! Good shot! Fuller around middle, Masakadza sits low and sweeps it through backward square leg. The fine leg is inside the circle and Sandakan from deep square leg cannot stop it going to his right.
Drives it through covers for a run.
Looks to reverse sweep this but misses. The keeper fumbles and allows a single.
50-run stand between Masakadza and Ervine!
Fuller outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Time for a change, Asela Gunaratne comes on for a bowl.
Once again, Hamilton looks to clip this one but misses. He is not picking Sandakan at all here.
Hamilton comes down to work it away but gets it off his pads towards the leg side. The keeper looks to take it but cannot reach it.
Bowls it too full on the stumps, Masakadza looks to sweep but is beaten. The players appeal but not long and hard. That did look close. Maybe there was an edge there?
Another reverse sweep attempted but this time the ball goes beneath the bat.
Full toss on the stumps, Ervine reverse sweeps it through point for a single.
Lands it outside off, Ervine defends it watchfully.

Shorter in length on middle and leg, Ervine looks to turn it through the leg side but gets it off his body. The ball does not carry to the keeper who fumbles and parries it towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.
This time Ervine gets right behind the line and defends it.
Back of a length on middle, Craig looks to clip it through but is hit on his body.
Sprays this one the pads again, Ervine cannot tuck it and the ball rolls down to fine leg. Two leg byes taken.
Punches this one through covers for a single.
Works it down to fine leg for a single.

DROPPED! No, surely not again! Bowls the wrong one around off, Masakadza looks to punch it off his back foot but does not keep it down and gets it off the toe end of the bat. The fielder at short cover dives to his left to grab it but cannot hold onto it. Gunathilaka was the culprit. He dropped a catch in the last game as well.
A slip comes in now.
FOUR! Fires it too full outside off, Masakadza unfurls a reverse sweep and gets it to the third man fence for a boundary.
No slips in place now.
Full toss outside off, this time Ervine gets it towards long leg for a single. The bowler is bowling wide to not allow such shots.
Bowls it outside off, Craig wants to sweep it from there but misses.
Lands it outside leg, swept to deep backward square leg for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, Masakadza looks to sweep but is hit on his pads.
Angles it outside off on a good length, Ervine defends it watchfully.
Short and wide outside off, Masakadza looks to flay it over third man but hits it on the bounce to Malinga going to his right in the deep. The breeze did not help his cause there.
WIDE! Short again outside off, Masakadza looks to pull at first but then bails out of the shot. Wide signaled for the height on that one.
Shorter in length on middle, forces Hamilton to duck under it.
Hurls it outside off, Masakadza mistimes his cut towards covers. He got a bottom edge there.
Good length around middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
Short and wide outside off, punched through point for a single. Chameera has changed ends here.
Shortish outside off, Ervine cuts it but the point fielder dives to his right and stops it.
Too full outside off, Masakadza sweeps it through backward square leg for a single. This shot was used a lot in the previous ODI and Sri Lanka need to find a way to stop them from playing it.
On middle and leg, turned to the left of the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Another googly outside off, Hamilton gets down and plays his premeditated sweep-pull through square leg for a single.
Tucks this one through square leg for a single.
Wrong 'un in line of the stumps, Ervine comes down swinging at it but gets hit on his back leg. The ball rolls towards short third man. Wasted a Free Hit there, Craig.
Free Hit coming up...
Starts with a no ball! Lands it outside off, Masakadza punches it through covers for a single. False start by him as he has overstepped.
Lakshan Sandakan comes on for a bowl. A slip in place for him.
Powerplay 2 signaled. Four fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle for the next thirty overs.

Fuller in length from round the wicket, Ervine pushes it back down the wicket. The bowler goes to his left and stops the ball. A decent Powerplay for both the sides. Zimbabwe will be happy to have not lost more than a wicket here. The hosts will be happy that they have kept the runs down.
Length ball around off, Ervine pushes it towards covers from his crease.
Shorter in length around middle and off, Ervine gets out of the way in time.
Full outside off, driven nicely to mid off by the batsman.
Back of a length outside off, Ervine punches it between cover and cover-point fielder. The fielder chases it down and keeps them to a couple of runs.
Shortish and wide outside off, Ervine throws his bat at it but cannot connect.
Gets away with one. Short again, wide again, Hamilton miss out this time as he finds the point fielder on his cut shot.
Length ball around off, Masakadza jumps across to clip it away but is hit on his pads. There is an appeal for lbw but it struck the batsman outside off. Better line and length this time.

FOUR! That is what Chameera has to work on! Short and pretty wide outside off, Masakadza waits for it and crunches it through point for a boundary. Good on Hamilton there to not lose his cool after the previous deliveries.
Masakadza makes the adjustment to get across and put this short one away but still cannot put it away. Chameera collects the ball and mimes the throw. This is good bowling by the young Lankan.
Similar length, Masakadza again fails to middle his cut shot. Chameera has begun well despite providing width at times.
Shortish outside off, Hamilton mistimes his cut towards covers.
WIDE! Short and wide outside off, Masakadza looks to flay it through but misses. The umpire signals it wide.
Length ball outside off, Ervine stands tall and crunches his punch to covers. Another good stop from the fielder. Sri Lanka need a lot more of this. Just two runs from the over.
Good length outside off, guided down to third man for a single.
Stays in his crease and defends this one.
Hurls it outside off on a length, a swing and miss from the batsman.
Good work again! Outside off on a fuller length, Ervine drives it to the right of mid off and takes off. Sandakan covers good ground and stops the ball. Only a single taken.
Ervine crashes this one towards covers where the fielder makes a superb stop. That was heading to the ropes.
Angles it around off on a fuller length, Masakadza looks to drive it through but gets it off the inner half towards mid on.
Similar length outside off, Masakadza punches it towards covers on the up.
Good length outside off, Hamilton comes forward and lets it go.
FOUR! Good shot! Short and wide outside off, this time Masakadza crashes it to the right of the point fielder for a boundary. He was trying the same thing on the previous ball.
Back of a length outside off, nips in, Masakadza wants to force it through but is beaten by the inward movement. He stares at the deck after that.
Hurls it outside off on a length, left alone by Masakadza.
Early change, Dushmantha Chameera brought on for a bowl.
Nervy start for Ervine! Outside off on a length, Ervine looks to place it on the off side but is beaten all ends up. That was not a convincing shot by him.
This time Ervine is happy to let one go as it is wide outside off.
Almost works! Angles it around off, Ervine looks to drive it through covers but is beaten all ends up. That was bowled from wide of the crease and it was the angle that did Craig in.
Pradeep goes round the wicket.
FOUR! Crashed! Short and wide from Pradeep, Ervine does not miss out and cuts it behind backward point for a boundary. Craig waited for this one and executed his shot to perfection.
Slight delay in play as there seems to be some issue near the sightscreen.
Sharp bouncer from Pradeep on middle and leg, Ervine ducks under it. The umpire signals it one for the over.
Full outside off, driven towards mid off by Ervine.
Outside off tempting Masakadza but the batsman resists it and lets it go through to the keeper.
Length ball around off, Hamilton comes forward and defends it.
Full again, this time it is driven straight to the fielder at mid on.
Length ball outside off, left alone.

FOUR! And again! Malinga angles it on the stumps, Hamilton shows the full face of the bat and gets it to the right of the bowler. The ball races away to the ropes. The two batsmen almost collide in the process of completing the first run. Masakadza has a history of being run out.
FOUR! Nicely done! Full outside off, Masakadza drives it back to the left of the bowler for a lovely boundary. That was sweetly timed. He has begun well here.
Full but down the leg side, Ervine cannot clip it through as the ball strikes him on the pads.
Length outside off, left alone by Craig.
This time he strays on the pads and is clipped through backward square leg for a couple.
An action replay of the previous delivery! Pradeep bowls it outside off on a length, Ervine looks to put bat to ball but misses it completely.
Doles it outside off, Ervine looks to drive it through the covers but fails to connect.
Craig Ervine is the new man in.

OUT! The hero of the last game has to depart! Pradeep bowls it just outside off on a back of a length, Mire looks to push it through the line but gets an outside edge. The ball flies nicely to Dickwella who takes it safely. Nuwan has struck early and Solomon has to walk back for a duck. What a leveler the game of cricket is. First duck for him in ODIs after a maiden ton in the previous game.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Takes full toll! Full and outside off, Masakadza drives it wide of the cover fielder for a boundary. This is a good start for the tourists.
Free Hit coming up....
No ball! Full outside off, Hamilton drives it back to the bowler who stops it in his followthrough. It is a no ball for overstepping. More worries for Lasith.
FOUR! Smashed! Width from Malinga outside off, Masakadza crunches it through covers for a boundary.
Masakadza comes forward and pushes it towards mid off.
Shorter in length around middle, Masakadza shapes to pull at first but then lets it go over him.
Fuller around off, Masakadza defends it watchfully.
Shortish outside off, left alone by Solomon.
Masakadza punches this one towards mid off. The fielder dives but cannot stop the ball cleanly. A single results.
Good length outside off, Hamilton plays inside the line of that one and is beaten all ends up.

Short ball again, Mire looks to pull but gets hit on his arm. Masakadza calls him through for a run. There is a direct hit at the striker's end but no harm done. First runs for the visitors in form of a leg bye.
A tad short outside off, Mire punches it towards the off side with an angled bat.
Angles this on the stumps, Mire defends it.
Nuwan Pradeep to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Punches this one on the up towards covers. A maiden over to start with for Lasith Malinga.
Turns this one towards the leg side.
Hamilton keeps this one out watchfully.

DROPPED! Not needed at all! Malinga bowls this fuller and on the stumps, Masakadza looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards second slip. Kusal Mendis looks to have it in control before spilling it out. Sri Lanka have started normally and they will want to change that. Poor Malinga though.
Good length outside off, Masakadza looks to push at this one outside off but is beaten all ends up.
Good length outside off, Masakadza defends it watchfully towards point.
The players are out in the middle. Solomon Mire and Hamilton Masakadza come out to bat. Lasith Malinga to begin the proceedings with the first new ball. Two slips in place. Here we go....

Zimbabwe skipper, Graeme Cremer says that he would have batted first. Reckons that it was a historic victory last time around where they chased a mammoth total down. Mentions that they will look to recreate the same magic even today. Informs that everyone was happy when they chased the total down in the last game. Ends by saying that they can beat any team on their day and they are also looking to carry on with the momentum.

Sri Lanka skipper, Angelo Mathews says that they are bowling due to the conditions. He thinks that the wicket is damp and he wants to take the advantage early. He is not sure of the score on this wicket and adds that they want to keep them to a minimum. Mentions that they did not panic. Informs that they just want to play good cricket. Three changes for them. Hasaranga comes in with Dushmantha Chameera. The two spinners are out along with Lahiru Madhushanka.
TOSS - Sri Lanka win the toss and opt to field.

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold reckons that the pitch is similar to the one in the first ODI. He expects plenty of runs again. He wants the spinners to bowl slower through the air. He opines that he will bat first as the pitch will slow down.

The visitors on the other hand will want to carry on the good work. They were brilliant with the bat and will aim to not let up of the intent they showed. Graeme Cremer will know that you can't always chase down 300, especially in Sri Lanka so he will need a better performance from his bowlers. Should be a good contest with no rain, hopefully. There was rain earlier which meant there were covers in place.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the 2nd ODI between Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe in Galle. The hosts having lost the first game of the series will be itching to come good today. Their bowling has lacked the aggressive intent to take wickets and Angelo Mathews will want to turn things around rather quickly.
